name: Fireman's BBQ Half Chicken with Seasoned Baked Beans
whyItWorks: While chicken meat is digestible, the fire-charred heavily seasoned skin and large side of brown sugar baked beans deliver high amounts of fermentable legumes that provoke severe cramps and gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bean & Char Warning: Strip off all blackened chicken skin, skip the baked beans entirely, and eat the lean white breast meat with a plain white roll.
